blocks.text: THE DRAGON EGG IS STILL MISSING!
Yes, dear viewers, the mystery continues! Despite our extensive coverage last week, the legendary dragon egg has still not found its way into the museum.
Naturally, Villager News decided to take matters into its own hands and launch an investigation.
After days of painstaking detective work, interrogating witnesses, following suspicious individuals, and looking very thoughtfully through a magnifying glass, I finally made a breakthrough!
I FOUND THE EGG!

It was hidden inside a **strange, black chest!** I *immediately* secured the evidence and was preparing to bring it back to the studio when I was suddenly **struck from behind and lost consciousness.**

When I awoke, **the egg was gone!** Vanished without a trace! And the chest was completely empty!

Clearly, we're dealing with a {dark_red}criminal mastermind.{/}
A reign of terror has swept through the village!
Several of our villager brethren were brutally slain by a mysterious maniac known only as **“Bob the Cunt.”** The murders took place on the night of November 16. A dark day for villagerkind indeed.

Rumors around town suggest that Bob is, in fact, **a zombie** attempting to recruit innocent villagers into his undead horde. Unfortunately, his recruitment methods appear to be a little too effective. {dark_red}*I heard he's eating their BRAINS*{/}
Authorities have yet to apprehend the suspect, although witnesses claim that Bob is simply having a **hard** time. Which is strange, because everyone else seems to think he's got it pretty **easy**.
On November 21, eight brave adventurers ventured into the End to defeat the Ender Dragon. Again!
Mathi_Craft, Lisnee2, xXWarCryXx, chimmochi_, kayushka, Senna_Roereitje, Noot_Noot__, and FriendOfTyse all joined the expedition.
After a fierce battle, several unfortunate deaths, the dragon was finally slain! **Hooray!**
Although this does raise a question. If we keep resurrecting the dragon just to kill it again, are we really the good guys here?
The first rule of Fight Club is...
A disturbing number of murders were reported on November 20, with Mathi_Craft and kayushka repeatedly killing each other.
Fortunately, it turns out Mathijs was simply training Kaya for PvP!
Excellent timing, too, because EchoinSilence and Detective_Mikey are currently building a **brand-new PvP arena!**
Soon, players will finally have somewhere to settle their differences like civilized people. *With swords.*
Are we still not done with this End segment?
Mathijs has been hard at work renovating the End!
After fixing some unfortunate flooding, he's been covering the island in slabs to prevent Endermen from spawning.
That's right! Our End spawn is slowly becoming an Enderman-free zone!

blocks.lead: We reached out to the local Endermen for comment, but they just screamed at us.

blocks.text: The server has been as busy as a beehive lately, with players working tirelessly on their homes, shops, highways, and other ambitious projects!
It's wonderful to see our little world growing into something so incredible, and here at Villager News, we couldn't be prouder of our community!
Keep up the amazing work, everyone!
*But please remember to sleep occasionally. Phantoms are becoming a real problem.*
{aqua}It's still raining. Of course.{/}
*Why am I surprised?*

blocks.caption: on our little slice of Voxel!
